name: SweetCookie
description: Run Minecraft Bedrock Edition Add-Ons on Minecraft Java Edition.
_comment: TODO(spike): the minecraft range must become per-node. A single broad range is wrong across the 1.21.11/26.2 seam and will let the mod load on a version it was not compiled for. SC-220 section 6 requires adding a version to touch only settings.gradle.kts and the properties file, so this metadata has to be generated, not hand-written.
